title: Explicit bug report: selectionStart and selectionEnd missing from applicable form fields
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

The `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd` properties are missing from most applicable form fields. Any field that uses text (with one logical exception), regardless of it's format _must_ support these properties.

Always applies to the following form field types:

- `date`
- `datetime-local`
- `email`
- `month`
- `number`
- `password`
- `search`
- `tel`
- `text`
- `time`
- `url`
- `week`

Always applies to the following form field types when they are Content Editable:
- `button`
- `reset`
- `submit`

Never applies to the following form field types:
- `checkbox`
- `color`
- `file`
- `hidden`
- `image`
- `radio`
- `range`

### Exception
The sole current exception of this rule is the file input as it does display text though acts purely as a button. The only room for potential debate is if the file input evolves to allow selecting one or multiple text representations of files while the browse button becomes the only part of the element to actually trigger the file picker modal. Since that is not currently the case, the file input element does not currently require supporting the `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd` properties.

### Text _is_ Text
The date input element allows the user to select the text representing only part of the total date. Regardless of whether the browser supports changing the individual values by pressing a key or not: highlighted text _is selected text_. Web developers require knowing what text is selected, hence the entire point of the `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd` properties.

### Ambiguity Removed
When a new type of form field is added though a browser does not yet explicitly support it then browsers display them as text fields. So unknown/non-supported form fields _must_ support the `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd` properties.

The currently bugged implementation can be viewed at the following URL:
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#input-type-attr-summary
